string.text: DiegeticControl
DiegeticControl
DiegeticControl sets the volume of each in-world sound source on its own, apart from the game's audio sliders. A change applies the moment you move a slider.
Master volume (x)
Multiplies every source on this page and every other scripted world sound. 1.0 is the game's volume.
Base, trader and camp radios and the music they play.
Radios
Off mutes every radio.
Radio volume (x)
Multiplies each radio's own volume. 1.0 is the game's volume.
Pause between tracks (x)
Stretches the silence between tracks. Above 1.0 the radio waits longer, and below 1.0 it plays more often.
Duty propaganda, the Arena announcer, alarms and announcements.
Megaphones
Off mutes every megaphone.
Megaphone volume (x)
Multiplies each megaphone's own volume. 1.0 is the game's volume.
Pause between announcements (x)
Stretches the silence between announcements. Above 1.0 the megaphone waits longer, and below 1.0 it speaks more often.
The guitar you play, from the Guitar Animation addon. Without the addon this section does nothing.
Guitar
Off makes the guitar play nothing.
Guitar volume (x)
Multiplies the guitar's volume. 1.0 is the addon's volume.
The harmonica you play, from the Harmonica addon. Without the addon this section does nothing.
Harmonica
Off makes the harmonica play nothing.
Harmonica volume (x)
Multiplies the harmonica's volume. 1.0 is the addon's volume.
General
Development
These are the tools for a bug report and for a clean start. The debug log writes each sound the mod adjusts to diegeticcontrol.log.
Debug log
Logs the theme and volume of each radio or megaphone the mod adjusts.
Warning: save or discard pending MCM changes first, otherwise they override the reset on the next Apply.
Reset to defaults
Restores every DiegeticControl setting to its default. Use it after an update that changed the menu.
DiegeticControl: all settings restored to defaults.
